cases.name: date-range-day
cases.description: A range with no times is drawn by day
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" range="2026-01-01..2026-01-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-range-second
cases.description: precision=second draws a second inside the range, not a day
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" range="2026-01-01T00:00:00..2026-01-01T23:59:59" format="ISO_TIME" precision="second"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-today
cases.description: today is the run clock, floored to the day
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" value="today" format="ISO"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-now
cases.description: now is the run clock to the millisecond, not floored to the day
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" value="now" format="ISO_TIME"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-open-ended-range
cases.description: a date generator given no bounds runs from 1970-01-01 to the run clock
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-birth
cases.description: person.b_day draws a millisecond, not a day
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="template" value="person.b_day" oldest="70" youngest="14" format="LL" local="en"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: every-format-token-one-instant
cases.description: Seventeen tokens no shared case reached: D, H, HH, m, mm, s, ss, SSS, YY, MMM, MMMM, ddd, dddd, L, Z, ZZ and ISO, all reading one fixed instant. The engine works in UTC, so Z and ZZ are the same on every machine — checked by running the reference under a second timezone before this was written down.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="T0"><gen type="date" range="2026-03-05T07:09:03..2026-03-05T07:09:03" format="D"/></sequence><sequence format="HH"/></sequence><sequence name="T3"><gen type="date" range="2026-03-05T07:09:03..2026-03-05T07:09:03" format="m"/></sequence><sequence name="T4"><gen type="date" format="SSS"/></sequence><sequence name="T8"><gen type="date" range="2026-03-05T07:09:03..2026-03-05T07:09:03" format="YY"/></sequence><sequence name="T9"><gen type="date" cases.name: the-two-long-localized-formats
cases.description: LLL and LLLL — month name, day, year and time, assembled per locale. Their own case because they carry commas, which a pipe-joined row would hide.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="T0"><gen type="date" range="2026-03-05T07:09:03..2026-03-05T07:09:03" format="LLL"/></sequence><sequence name="T1"><gen type="date" range="2026-03-05T07:09:03..2026-03-05T07:09:03" format="LLLL"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{T0}} / ${{T1}}</data></line></block></tdc>
